name: Elen Sargsyan
bio:
Elen is a Research Fellow at the Augmented Human Lab (AHLab) at the National University of Singapore (NUS). She holds a PhD in Human-Computer Interaction and Cognitive Sciences from the University of Toulouse, France.

Her research focuses on accessibility, assistive technologies for people with visual impairments, and user-centered design. In her free time, she enjoys exploring new AI-powered design tools and experimenting with creative technologies.
